# Bitwise Operators

a & b;
a | b;
a ^ b;
~a;
a << b;
a >> b;
a >>> b;

==>

Program(TopLevelExpression(BinaryExpression(Identifier,"&",Identifier),";"),TopLevelExpression(BinaryExpression(Identifier,"|",Identifier),";"),TopLevelExpression(BinaryExpression(Identifier,"^",Identifier),";"),TopLevelExpression(UnaryExpression("~",Identifier),";"),TopLevelExpression(BinaryExpression(Identifier,ShiftOp,Identifier),";"),TopLevelExpression(BinaryExpression(Identifier,ShiftOp,Identifier),";"),TopLevelExpression(BinaryExpression(Identifier,ShiftOp,Identifier),";"))

# Compound Assignment

a += b;
a -= b;
a *= b;
a /= b;
a %= b;
a ~/= b;
a <<= b;
a &= b;
a |= b;
a ^= b;

==>

Program(TopLevelExpression(AssignmentExpression(Pattern(PrimaryPattern(Identifier)),CompoundAssign,Identifier),";"),TopLevelExpression(AssignmentExpression(Pattern(PrimaryPattern(Identifier)),CompoundAssign,Identifier),";"),TopLevelExpression(AssignmentExpression(Pattern(PrimaryPattern(Identifier)),CompoundAssign,Identifier),";"),TopLevelExpression(AssignmentExpression(Pattern(PrimaryPattern(Identifier)),CompoundAssign,Identifier),";"),TopLevelExpression(AssignmentExpression(Pattern(PrimaryPattern(Identifier)),CompoundAssign,Identifier),";"),TopLevelExpression(AssignmentExpression(Pattern(PrimaryPattern(Identifier)),CompoundAssign,Identifier),";"),TopLevelExpression(AssignmentExpression(Pattern(PrimaryPattern(Identifier)),CompoundAssign,Identifier),";"),TopLevelExpression(AssignmentExpression(Pattern(PrimaryPattern(Identifier)),CompoundAssign,Identifier),";"),TopLevelExpression(AssignmentExpression(Pattern(PrimaryPattern(Identifier)),CompoundAssign,Identifier),";"),TopLevelExpression(AssignmentExpression(Pattern(PrimaryPattern(Identifier)),CompoundAssign,Identifier),";"))

# Precedence

a + b * c;
a | b & c;
a || b && c;

==>

Program(TopLevelExpression(BinaryExpression(Identifier,"+",BinaryExpression(Identifier,"*",Identifier)),";"),TopLevelExpression(BinaryExpression(Identifier,"|",BinaryExpression(Identifier,"&",Identifier)),";"),TopLevelExpression(BinaryExpression(Identifier,"||",BinaryExpression(Identifier,"&&",Identifier)),";"))
